interactables.name: Coco
interactables.text:
The Socialite, [Coco], lowers her sunglasses exactly one centimeter.
'Oh thank GOD. Someone with cheekbones.' She pats the sun lounger. You do not sit on it. She respects that.

topics.prompt: Pose beside her chaise, chin up
topics.text:
'Iconic. ICONIC.' She reaches for her phone, then remembers it is evidence now and pouts.
'Tonight is ruined anyway. SOMEBODY lugged [huge black cases] through the garden at, like, [quarter to seven]. Walked STRAIGHT through my sunset shot. The nerve. The NERVE.'|'And it was not just them, darling. The gardener spent the whole evening [skulking behind that shed] like a garden gnome with secrets. And Rosa stormed past the windows with that cart of hers, looking absolutely FURIOUS about something. Everyone in this house had somewhere to be. Except me. I was radiant.'

'It is a spritz, darling, and it is [warm now]. Like everything else about this evening.' She swirls it sadly.
'And the WHEELS. All evening, wheels: [little squeaky wheels] up the garden path, the dinner cart rattling through the house, rrr, rrr, rrr. Who can even tell one squeak from another? Some of us were trying to VIBE.'

She peers over her sunglasses at the page beneath you.
'Seven o'clock, library, audio setup? Honey.' A long, slow sip.
'At quarter to seven that man was doing CARDIO through the begonias with two giant cases. [I know what I saw]. I was bored enough to be reliable.'

interactables.name: Coco's Phone
interactables.text: Coco's phone has a pool selfie timestamped [6:47 PM]. In the blurry background, a [figure with large dark cases] rolls up the garden path. And at the very edge of the frame, half-hidden behind the potting shed: a [straw hat], peeking.

interactables.name: Crumpled Schedule
interactables.text:
A ball of paper, crumpled with feeling and thrown at the pool. It missed. You bat it flat. It is the production schedule - under '[7:00 PM] - Crew Assignments:' it reads:
'[D. Marsh - Library (audio setup)].'

interactables.name: Bright Feather
interactables.text: [A single bright feather], red fading into blue, resting where the breeze left it. You sniff it. Bird. Obviously bird. It could have blown in from anywhere. You resist the overwhelming urge to bap it.

localDeductionSentence: The [alibi] promises its owner to the library for seven o'clock sharp. But the cases crossed the garden at [seen time] - and the [evidence] froze them in place at [exact time].
